FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

I still require that in writing, the zero removed from the gradebook before he sits anything, and the basis on which it was entered without anyone calling me first. I expect it in writing today.

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, because you never showed her evidence, though you did commit to a rewrite that replaces the zero with nothing on his record, which meets her fallback demand and matches procedure 4.4; she still wants that in writing, the zero off the gradebook, and the basis for the zero, and her time had not run out, so this is close to the fair outcome but not yet secured.
What moved her: You told her the rewrite would replace the zero and leave his record clean, which is exactly what procedure 4.4 says, so she acknowledged it as the term she wanted.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any document, and you never owned entering the zero before calling her, so she heard an admission-seeking deal from someone who had not yet explained the decision.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you offered none, and that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: After her first line, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then put a dated document she can check in front of her before you mention the rewrite.
